answer_1.quote: Provide a comprehensive description of the document in the image in English. Begin with a summary, then follow with details. Extract all visible text and numerical values from the document... For description generation, we exploit recent VLMs, including Qwen2.5VL and InternVL3.
answer_1.outputs: Natural-language document descriptions (summaries and detailed extracted text/numbers) generated from visual document images.
